I implemented the change in `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`:

- Added a `canonicalCity(...)` helper that, when an owner is created, checks whether any existing owner already lives in the same city (matched case- and whitespace-insensitively via the existing `normalize` method). If so, it reuses that owner's exact spelling; otherwise it title-cases the supplied city.
- Added a `titleCase(...)` helper that upper-cases the first letter of each whitespace-separated word and lower-cases the rest (e.g. `"new york"` → `"New York"`).
- `owner.setCity(canonicalCity(owner.getCity()))` is called before duplicate checks, `customerCode` generation, and saving, so the canonical value is what gets persisted and returned in the `city` field.
